title: 12 Things a Godly Man Does in His Twenties That He'll Thank God for at 40
caption:
12 things a godly man does in his twenties that he'll thank God for at 40.

None of these are flashy. Pay off the small debt. Keep the friend who tells you the truth. Take the unglamorous job and work it well. Apologize first. Pray before you decide, not after.

Your twenties aren't a waiting room. They're where the foundation gets poured. Pick two from the list and start this week.

Save this and send it to a brother.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #discipline #twenties #character
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
